findings.summary: Owner isolation, private defaults, restore-without-regrant, payload-aware idempotency, flag-off/unauthenticated 404, same-origin writes, and fail-closed unapplied SQL had no medium-or-higher findings on exact candidate bbebce4b0dc1bd76c0497e6a370b00b5fcede30c.

Entry-policy writes require the same-origin custom header and Origin match. Sec-Fetch-Site is not also checked, unlike some sibling APIs. That is defense-in-depth only and was not a blocking CSRF path.
Proposed SQL stays unapplied and unallowlisted. SqlEntryPolicyRepository does not call the proposed commit procedure. Live schema, identity, providers, and production remain withheld.
